blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Spatial intelligence has emerged as a central capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs),
enabling them to understand and reason about both static 3D structure and dynamic 4D environments, supporting applications ranging from scene understanding ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Cao et al., 2026 ) to embodied interaction ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026b ) .
Recent post-training methods have substantially improved static 3D reasoning ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) , while parallel efforts have extended spatial reasoning to dynamic 4D environments ( Zhou et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025d ) .
Yet these directions remain largely specialized: 3D-oriented models often lack dynamic understanding, whereas 4D-oriented models remain limited in static 3D reasoning. This gap motivates a unified model capable of strong spatial reasoning across both static and dynamic environments.
blocks.zh:
空间情报已成为多式联运大语文模型的核心能力,
使他们能够了解静态三维结构和动态四维环境并作出解释,支持从场景理解到各种应用(Yang等,2025a; Cao等人,2026年)来体现相互作用(Lin等,2025年;Li等,2025年b;Yang等,2026年b.).
最近的培训后方法大大改善了静态3D推理(Tong等,2024;Zhang等,2025a;Yin等,2025;Li等,2025a),同时努力将空间推理扩大到动态4D环境(Zhou等,2025b; 周来等,2025a; 周来. 张等,2025b;李等,2025d.).
然而,这些方向在很大程度上仍然是专门的:面向3D的模型往往缺乏动态的理解,而面向4D的模型在静态3D推理中仍然有限. 这一差距激发了一个能够跨越静态和动态环境的强大空间推理的统一模型.

blocks.en:
However, unified spatial reasoning is challenging, as improving one capability can come at the expense of the other. We find that 3D-focused spatial post-training can interfere with pretrained dynamic competence: improvements in static 3D reasoning are accompanied by substantial degradation on dynamic 4D benchmarks ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) . This trade-off leads to imbalanced capability profiles shown in Figure 1 , revealing spatial–dynamic interference that hinders joint capability improvement.
Existing capability-preservation strategies provide only partial remedies.
Data replay requires auxiliary data and careful mixing, regularization can limit adaptation, and parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) may restrict update capacity. The central challenge is therefore to preserve existing dynamic competence while allowing sufficient flexibility to strengthen static 3D reasoning, without relying on replay data or additional regularization objectives.
blocks.zh:
然而,统一的空间推理具有挑战性,因为提高一种能力可能牺牲另一种能力。 我们发现,以3D为重点的空间后培训会干扰预先训练的动态能力:静态3D推理的改进伴随着动态4D基准的大量退化(周等,2025b.). 这种取舍导致图1所示能力分布不平衡,揭示出阻碍联合能力提高的空间-动力干扰.
现有的能力保护战略只提供部分补救。
数据回放需要辅助数据和仔细混合,规范化可以限制适应,LORA(Hu等,2022年)等参数高效方法可能限制更新能力. 因此,主要的挑战是保留现有的动态能力,同时允许有足够的灵活性来加强静态的三维推理,而不依赖于重放数据或额外的规范化目标.

blocks.en:
To better understand this interference, we analyze 3D-specialized VLMs through checkpoint interpolation and parameter-group restoration.
We find that the interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs, as shown in Figure 2 .
Restoring these parameters to their pretrained values substantially recovers dynamic performance, while partially reversing the gains in static 3D reasoning. This opposing response indicates that the tension between static 3D enhancement and dynamic capability preservation is particularly pronounced in late-layer MLPs.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地理解这种干扰,我们通过检查站内插和参数组修复分析3D专用VLM.
我们发现,如图2所显示的,这种干扰在各种参数组中高度不统一,静态和动态能力之间的平衡对后层MLP的变化特别敏感。
将这些参数恢复到其被预先训练的值上,大大恢复了动态性能,同时部分逆转了静态3D推理中的收益. 这种对立的反应表明,静态3D增强和动态能力保存之间的紧张关系在后期的MLP中特别突出.

blocks.en:
Motivated by these observations, we propose DynThinker, a unified spatial reasoning framework that addresses spatial–dynamic interference through complementary designs.
First, Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) mitigates interference through configurable group-wise temporal averaging, allowing stronger consolidation for interference-sensitive parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. The decay is adjusted according to the number of EMA updates, ensuring consistency across training schedules.
Second, Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements parameter preservation with joint spatial–dynamic perception by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations. Guided by the VLM’s semantic context, SDF adaptively modulates contribution of each prior stream, enabling model to capture both static geometric structure and temporal evolution.
blocks.zh:
基于这些观察,我们提出DynThinker,一个统一的空间推理框架,通过互补设计解决空间动力干扰。
首先,脱钩指数移动平均值(D-EMA)通过可配置的组位时间平均来减轻干扰,从而可以更有力地巩固对干扰敏感的参数,同时保持增强能力的灵活性。 衰变根据EMA更新的次数进行调整,确保培训时间表的一致性。
第二,空间-动态聚合(SDF)通过有选择地将动态几何编码器的空间和时间前兆整合到中间VLM表达中,以联合空间-动力感知来补充参数保存. 以VLM的语义上下文为取向,SDF适应地调制了每道前流的贡献,使模型既能够捕捉静态几何结构,又能够捕捉时间演化.

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments demonstrate strong and balanced performance across static 3D and dynamic 4D reasoning. Across ten metrics, DynThinker achieves the highest average score of 60.5, surpassing the proprietary frontier model GPT-5.6 Sol at 59.5, while also attaining state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models on ReVSI, DSR-Bench, and DSI-Bench. Ablation studies further confirm the complementary roles of D-EMA and SDF in mitigating spatial–dynamic interference while strengthening spatial reasoning, showing that spatial specialization need not come at the expense of dynamic capabilities.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:

广泛的实验表明,在静态3D和动态4D推理之间,表现有力而平衡. DynThinker在10个度数中实现了60.5的最高平均得分,超过了专有前沿模型GPT-5.6 Sol at 59.5,同时在ReVSI,DSR-Bench和DSI-Bench的比较开源模型中也取得了最先进的结果. 校正研究进一步证实了D-EMA和SDF在减轻空间-动力干扰的同时加强空间推理方面的互补作用,表明空间专业化不需要牺牲动态能力.
我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Static and Dynamic Spatial Intelligence
blocks.zh: 2.1 静态和动态空间情报

blocks.en:
Progress toward real-world spatial intelligence requires vision–language models (VLMs) to reason about both static spatial structure and dynamic changes over time.
Early work explores image-based spatial reasoning, with SpatialVLM learning qualitative and metric spatial relations from automatically generated image–question pairs ( Chen et al., 2024a ) .
Beyond individual images, benchmarks such as VSI-Bench and MindCube require models to integrate observations across multiple views and reason about 3D scene layout, spatial relationships, and metric properties ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025c ) .
Recent work has extended spatial intelligence toward dynamic 4D settings, with benchmarks spanning complementary data sources and reasoning targets that together motivate unified reasoning across static 3D and dynamic 4D.
VLM4D combines real and synthetic videos to assess motion, viewpoint changes, and temporal continuity ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) , while DSI-Bench focuses on disentangling observer motion from object motion ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) . DSR-Bench instead builds on real-world videos to evaluate evolving 3D relations and multi-object interactions ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , and MLLM4D-Bench uses scenarios derived from stereo videos to probe spatial and temporal reasoning ( Yin et al., 2026 ) .
Building on these efforts, we study how to jointly strengthen static and dynamic spatial capabilities during post-training.

除了单个图像之外,VSI-Bench和MindCube等基准要求模型将关于3D场景布局、空间关系和计量属性的多种观点和理由的观测结合起来(Yang等,2025a; Yin等,2025; Yang等,2025c.).
最近的工作将空间智能扩展至动态四维设置,其基准涵盖互补数据源和推理目标,共同激励跨静态三维和动态四维的统一推理.
VLM4D结合了真实和合成的视频来评估运动,视角变化,以及时间连续性(周克等,2025b),而DSI-Bench则专注于将观察者运动从物体运动中分离出来(张克等,2025b.). DSR-Bench则以真实世界的视频为基础来评价不断发展的3D关系和多物体相互作用(周克等,2025a.),而MLLM4D-Bench则利用从立体视频中衍生出来的情景来探测空间和时间推理(Yin等,2026.
在这些努力的基础上,我们研究如何在培训后共同加强静态和动态空间能力。

blocks.en: 2.2 Geometry Integration in Vision–Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 远景-语言模型中的几何综合

blocks.en:
To equip VLMs with stronger 3D and 4D reasoning, methods augment semantic visual features with explicit geometric cues ( Wang et al., 2026a ) .
Geometry encoders include VGGT, which recovers 3D scene structure from multiple views ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and V-DPM, which extends geometric reconstruction to dynamic scenes with 3D motion estimation ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) . Existing methods incorporate geometric knowledge into VLMs through input-level feature fusion ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , distillation ( Li et al., 2025b ) , and intermediate-layer integration ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
For static and dynamic spatial reasoning, DSR-GSM uses π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2026b ) to capture both scene geometry and motion, together with stacked Q-Formers to select question-relevant features for VLM integration ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) . GeoSR improves geometric evidence use through geometry-unleashing masking and geometry-guided fusion, while employing separate models for static and dynamic reasoning ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Building on GeoThinker’s semantic-guided intermediate-layer integration ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we introduce Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) to fuse complementary spatial and dynamic priors within a single VLM, adaptively balancing their contributions.

几何编码器包括从多处视图中恢复出3D场景结构的VGGT(Wang等,2025a),和以3D运动估计法将几何重建延伸到动态场景的V-DPM(Sucar等,2026). 现有方法通过输入级特征聚变(郑等,2025年)将几何知识纳入VLM. (Li等,2025b),和中间层融合(Li等,2026.

blocks.en: 2.3 Capability Preservation during Post-Training
blocks.zh: 2.3 培训后保存能力

blocks.en:
Specialized post-training can improve target performance while degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon observed in language models and other adaptation settings, including embodied models ( Kotha et al., 2024 ; Hancock et al., 2026 ) .
Weight averaging provides one approach to balancing adaptation and capability retention: WiSE-FT interpolates pretrained and fine-tuned checkpoints to improve robustness ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) , while SWA ( Izmailov et al., 2018 ) and EMA ( Morales-Brotons et al., 2024 ) aggregate parameter states within a training run to improve generalization. Prior work has examined how EMA hyperparameters should adapt to training scale, such as batch size ( Busbridge et al., 2023 ) .
In spatial post-training, however, we find that capability interference is unevenly distributed across parameter groups, calling for more targeted control over the balance between static and dynamic capabilities. Motivated by this observation, D-EMA applies configurable group-wise averaging horizons, normalized by training duration, to mitigate interference while retaining sufficient flexibility for capability enhancement across training scales.
blocks.zh:
专业培训后可以提高目标性能,同时降低以前获得的能力,这是在语言模型和其他适应环境中观察到的现象,包括体现的模式(Kotha等,2024;Hancock等,2026)。
平均重量为平衡适应和能力保留提供了一种方法: WISE-FT 插上经过预先培训和精细调整的检查站,以提高坚固性(Wortsman等,2022年),而SWA(Izmailov等,2018年)和EMA(Morales-Brotons等,2024年)在一次训练赛中汇总参数,以提高通俗性. 先前的工作审查了EMA超参数应如何适应培训规模,如批量规模(Busbridge等,2023年)。
然而,在空间培训后,我们发现能力干扰在参数组中的分布不均,要求更有针对性的控制静态能力和动态能力的平衡。 在这项观察的推动下,D-EMA采用了可配置的团体平均视野,并随着培训时间的延长而正常化,以减少干扰,同时保持足够的灵活性来提高整个培训规模的能力。

blocks.en: 3 Diagnosing Spatial–Dynamic Interference
blocks.zh: 3 空间动态干扰分析

(A) Interpolation between Qwen3-VL-8B and its 3D-specialized counterpart ( Li et al., 2026 ) improves VSI-Bench but degrades VLM4D, revealing a clear spatial–dynamic interference. (C) D-EMA uses configurable temporal averaging to consolidate interference-sensitive pretrained parameters during adaptation. blocks.en:
To understand why existing specialization struggles to achieve unified spatial reasoning, we first examine how 3D-focused post-training reshapes the balance between static and dynamic capabilities in a pretrained VLM.
As shown in Figure 2 (A), interpolating between the Qwen3-VL-8B ( Qwen Team, 2025b ) model and its 3D-specialized counterpart GeoThinker ( Li et al., 2026 ) reveals opposing trends: performance on VSI-Bench steadily improves, while performance on VLM4D consistently declines.
Notably, static 3D performance begins to saturate at intermediate interpolation coefficients, whereas dynamic 4D performance continues to decline toward the 3D-specialized checkpoint. This opposing trajectory reveals spatial–dynamic interference during post-training: improving static 3D reasoning can progressively erode dynamic competence inherited from pretraining.
blocks.zh:
为了理解为什么现有的专业为实现统一的空间推理而挣扎,我们首先考察了3D聚焦后训练如何在预先训练的VLM中重塑静态能力和动态能力的平衡.
如图2(A)所示,从Quen3-VL-8B(Quen Team,2025b)模式与其3D专业对应GeoThinker(Li等,2026年)之间的插值显示出相反的趋势:VSI-Bench的性能稳步改善,而VLM4D的性能持续下降.
值得注意的是,静态3D性能开始在中间插值系数下饱和,而动态4D性能则继续向3D专用检查站下降. 这种相反的轨迹揭示出后期训练时的空间-动力干扰:改进静态3D推理会逐渐侵蚀从前期训练中继承的动态能力.

blocks.en:
This observation raises a central question: which parameters drive this interference, and can dynamic competence be preserved without constraining static 3D adaptation?
To answer this, we conduct a parameter-group sensitivity analysis by selectively restoring different modules and layer ranges in the 3D-specialized model toward their pretrained values and measuring the resulting changes in static and dynamic performance.
As shown in Figure 2 (B), the effect varies substantially across parameter groups: restoring late-layer MLPs recovers substantially more dynamic performance than other groups, but also partially reverses the static 3D gains acquired during post-training. This contrasting response indicates that spatial–dynamic interference is particularly pronounced in late-layer MLPs.
These observations motivate configurable temporal consolidation across parameter groups.
Interference-sensitive parameters should be preserved more strongly, while less sensitive parameters should retain greater flexibility for capability enhancement. Detailed analyses of parameter sensitivity are provided in Appendices H.1 and H.2 .
blocks.zh:
这一观察提出了一个中心问题:哪些参数可以驱动这种干扰,而动态能力可以保留而不限制静态3D适应?
为了回答这个问题,我们进行了参数组敏感性分析,有选择地恢复了3D专业模型中不同的模块和地层范围,朝向它们预受训练的值并测量由此产生的静态和动态性能的变化.
如图2(B)所显示的,不同参数组的效果相差很大:恢复后层的MLP比其他组群恢复了多得多的动态性能,但也部分逆转了训练后取得的静态3D增益. 这种对比反应表明,空间-动力干扰在后层的MLP中特别明显.
这些观测结果推动了各参数组之间可描述的时间整合。
应更有力地保留对干涉敏感的参数,而对加强能力不太敏感的参数应保持更大的灵活性。 附录H.1和H.2提供了参数敏感性的详细分析。

blocks.en:
These findings motivate a selective preservation strategy that can constrain interference-sensitive parameters without restricting the overall adaptation process. Temporal weight averaging provides a soft mechanism for this purpose. Unlike hard freezing, it consolidates parameter states throughout training while leaving the online adaptation process unconstrained, allowing the model to adapt while retaining influence from earlier states.
Standard EMA, however, applies a shared averaging horizon to all parameters and therefore does not account for their different sensitivities to specialization.
We therefore introduce Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) , which assigns configurable averaging horizons to pretrained parameter groups, allowing stronger consolidation to more sensitive groups while allowing others greater flexibility in Figure 2 (C). The formulation is detailed in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh:
这些结论促使采取有选择的保全战略,在不限制总体适应进程的情况下限制对干扰敏感的参数。 平均时间重量为这一目的提供了一个软机制。 与硬冻不同的是,它整合了整个培训过程中的参数状态,同时使在线适应过程不受限制,使模型在保持来自更早的州的影响的同时能够适应.
然而,标准EMA对所有参数采用了共同平均视野,因此没有考虑到它们对于专业化的不同敏感性。
因此,我们引入了脱钩指数移动平均值(D-EMA),它为预先训练的参数组分配了可配置的平均值,允许对更敏感的组进行更强有力的整合,同时允许其他组在图2(C)中具有更大的灵活性。 第4.3节详细介绍了这一表述。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 (C) further shows that D-EMA remains effective as post-training scales.
Without D-EMA, increasing the amount of post-training data leads to progressively greater degradation in dynamic reasoning. In contrast, D-EMA preserves dynamic competence while allowing static 3D performance to continue benefiting from additional data.
This suggests that spatial–dynamic interference can intensify with training scale and that group-wise temporal averaging remains effective across data regimes.
D-EMA thus provides optimization-side capability preservation while retaining sufficient flexibility for joint spatial–dynamic enhancement.
blocks.zh:
图2(C)还表明,D-EMA作为培训后的尺度仍然有效。
如果没有D-EMA,培训后数据数量的增加会导致动态推理的逐渐退化. 相形之下,D-EMA保留了动态能力,同时允许静态3D性能继续从额外数据中受益.
这表明,空间动力干扰可以随着培训规模而加剧,而分组时间平均率在各数据制度中依然有效。
因此,D-EMA提供优化侧能力保存,同时保持足够的灵活性来增强联合空间动力。

Our framework integrates complementary spatial and dynamic priors from a dynamic geometry encoder through Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) layers. Importance Gating uses the VLM’s semantic context to selectively modulate both feature streams, enabling joint reasoning about geometric structure and temporal dynamics.

blocks.en:
DynThinker unifies static 3D and dynamic 4D reasoning through two complementary components: Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) for joint capability enhancement and Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) for interference-aware capability preservation.
As illustrated in Figure 3 , SDF integrates complementary spatial and temporal features from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations, adaptively modulated by the VLM’s semantic context. During post-training, D-EMA applies group-specific temporal averaging to pretrained parameters, balancing capability preservation with sufficient flexibility for adaptation.
The model architecture, SDF, and D-EMA are detailed in Sections 4.1 , 4.2 , and 4.3 , respectively.
blocks.zh:
DynThinker通过两个互补组件统一了静态3D和动态4D推理:用于联合能力增强的空间-动态融合(SDF)和用于干涉-意识能力保存的去耦合的能动平均(D-EMA).
如图3所说明的,SDF将动态几何编码器的互补空间和时间特征整合到中间VLM表示中,由VLM的语义上下调而来. 在培训后,D-EMA将特定群体的时间平均值用于预先训练的参数,兼顾能力保持和适应的充分灵活性。

blocks.en: Dynamic Geometry Encoder. To provide geometric priors for both spatial structure and temporal dynamics, we adopt VDPM ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) as our dynamic geometry encoder. As shown in Figure 3 , VDPM consists of a VGGT-based backbone ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and a time-variant decoder. We extract intermediate features from both components: encoder features provide spatial geometry priors, while decoder features capture temporal variations across the sequence. Together, these streams supply complementary spatial and dynamic information for reasoning.

blocks.en: To incorporate complementary spatial and dynamic priors into the VLM, we introduce Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF). As illustrated in Figure 3 , SDF uses intermediate semantic representations to modulate the contribution of each prior stream through spatial and dynamic importance gating, together with global scaling.

blocks.en: 5 Experiment
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we first introduce the implementation details and training datasets, followed by evaluations on spatial and dynamic reasoning benchmarks in Section 5.1 . We then present ablation studies and scaling behavior in Section 5.2 .
Additional controlled experiments and downstream evaluations are presented in the Appendix F.1 , I.1 and G.1 .

在本节中,我们首先介绍实施细节和培训数据集,然后对第5.1节中的空间和动态推理基准进行评价。 然后我们在第5.2节中 提出减肥研究和放大行为
附录F.1、I.1和G.1列出了其他有控制的实验和下游评价。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We train DynThinker with a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , using 32 input frames per scene and m = 8 m=8 decoded frames in VDPM. The fusion ratio is set to r fusion = 0.5 r_{\mathrm{fusion}}=0.5 , and the D-EMA layer boundary is b = 4 b=4 . To accommodate broader adaptation during scaled training, we use a D-EMA decay of 0.999834 0.999834 for pretrained parameters, while newly introduced modules are excluded from averaging. D-EMA starts after 150 optimization steps and updates every 10 steps. Training uses 16 PPU-ZW810E accelerators with 96GB memory each.

blocks.en: Training Data. Our training mixture contains approximately 2.68M samples, extending GeoThinker’s scaled data recipe ( Li et al., 2026 ) . It includes sampled SPAR-7M ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and the LLaVA-Hound split of LLaVA-Video-178K ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , spatial instruction data from VLM-3R ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , VSI-590K ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , and MindCube ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , and 430k general video samples from ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . The mixture also includes 13K DSR ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) samples associated with 2,000 videos, covering 26% of its official training data, and 1M MLLM4D samples from ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , covering 50% of its training set.

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价结果

blocks.en: We conduct evaluation across multiple benchmarks, including (1) Spatial statics: ReVSI ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025c ) , MindCube-Tiny ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , ViewSpatial ( Li et al., 2025a ) , SITE ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , CV-Bench ( Tong et al., 2024 ) and (2) Temporal dynamics: VLM4D ( Zhou et al., 2025b ) , DSR-Bench ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , DSI-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) with sample-wise and group-wise protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们通过多个基准进行评价,包括:(1) 空间静态:ReVSI(张等,2026b),VSI-Bench(杨等,2025a),MMSI-Bench(杨等,2025c),MindCube-Tiny。 (Yin等,2025年). ViewSpatial. (Li等,2025a.),SITE(Wang等,2025c.),CV-Bench(Tong等,2024.)和(2) 时间动态:VLM4D(周等,2025b.),DSR-Bench(周等,2025a.),DSI-Bench(Zhang等,2025b.) 具有抽样和分组协议.

blocks.en:
Cross-benchmark evaluation. Table 1 evaluates static 3D and dynamic 4D reasoning across a broad benchmark suite.
Our 8B model achieves the highest average score of 60.3, outperforming all compared open-source models.
Compared with 3D-specialized models, DynThinker substantially strengthens dynamic 4D reasoning while retaining strong static 3D performance. It outperforms GeoThinker, which shares the same Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, by 11.2 points on average and improves all four dynamic metrics. In particular, VLM4D accuracy rises from 42.4 to 60.0, recovering the pretrained backbone’s performance, while DSR-Bench increases from 30.9 to 67.7.
Compared with 4D-specialized models, including MLLM-4D-RFT, GeoSR-4D, and DSR-GSM, DynThinker achieves higher scores across static and dynamic metrics, showing that dynamic gains need not sacrifice static 3D capability. Relative to general VLMs, DynThinker raises the pretrained Qwen3-VL-8B average from 44.0 to 60.3 and surpasses GPT-5.6 Sol by 0.8 points. Overall, DynThinker achieves a stronger and more balanced static–dynamic capability within a unified model.
blocks.zh:
跨基准评价. 表1评价了静态的3D和动态的4D推理,跨越了广泛的基准套件.
我们的8B模式实现最高的平均分是60.3分,比所有开源模式都好。
与3D-专用模型相比,DynThinker在保持强静态3D性能的同时,大大加强了动态4D推理. 它的性能超过了GeoThinker,GeoThinker拥有相同的Quen3-VL-8B骨干,平均比11.2分,并改进了所有四个动态度量. 特别是,VLM4D精度从42.4升至60.0,恢复了被预先训练的骨干性能,而DSR-Bench则从30.9升至67.7.
相较于包括MLLM-4D-RFT,GeoSR-4D,和DSR-GSM在内的4D专业模型,DynThinker在静态和动态度量衡上实现更高的分数,表明动态增益不需要牺牲静态3D能力. 相对于一般的VLM,DynThinker将预训的Qwen3-VL-8B平均从44.0提高到60.3,并超过GPT-5.6 Sol0.8分. 总体而言,DynThinker在一个统一的模型中实现了更强大和更加平衡的静态-动力学能力.

blocks.en:
Spatial reasoning on ReVSI. To complement the cross-benchmark comparison, we evaluate DynThinker on ReVSI in Table 2 , which adapts ground-truth answers to the evaluated frame count.
Under the same 128-frame budget, DynThinker surpasses Cambrian-P by 4.0 percentage points and slightly improves upon GeoThinker’s 55.9%, with gains in object and room size estimation, relative distance, and relative direction.
These results demonstrate that DynThinker maintains strong 3D spatial reasoning alongside its improved dynamic capabilities.
blocks.zh:
ReVSI上的空间推理. 为了补充跨基准比较,我们在表2中评价了ReVSI上的DynThinker,该表将地面真实的答案适应了被评价的框架计数.
在同样的128框架预算中,DynThinker比Cambrian-P高了4.0个百分点,比GeoThinker的55.9%稍有改善,在物体和房间面积估计、相对距离和相对方向方面都有了进步。
这些结果表明,DynThinker在增强动态能力的同时保持了强大的3D空间推理.

blocks.en: Effect of inference-time token compression. Disabling token compression at inference yields a modest increase in the average score, from 60.3 to 60.5. VLM4D improves from 60.0 to 62.3, and scores under both DSI evaluation protocols also increase, whereas VSI-Bench decreases from 69.3 to 67.8. These results suggest that retaining more visual tokens can benefit dynamic reasoning, but the gains are task-dependent and do not consistently translate to better overall performance.
blocks.zh: 推论时间符号压缩的效果. 按推算,破坏符号压缩使平均分数略有增加,从60.3分增加到60.5分. VLM4D从60.0升至62.3,在DSI评价协议下得分也有所增加,而VSI-Bench则从69.3降至67.8. 这些结果表明,保留更多的可视化符号可以有利于动态推理,但收益取决于任务,不能一致地转化为更好的总体业绩.

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.2 读取研究

blocks.en:
Component Ablations and Model Scaling. Table 3 (a) incrementally builds DynThinker upon GeoThinker under the same data recipe and training schedule with the Qwen3-VL-4B backbone.
Adding D-EMA to GeoThinker improves VSI-Bench from 51.31 to 53.14 and VLM4D from 45.20 to 53.57, recovering much of the dynamic performance lost during specialization while also improving static spatial reasoning.
This substantial dynamic recovery shows that D-EMA effectively mitigates the interference introduced during 3D-specialized post-training.
Replacing the geometry encoder with VDPM provides additional gains, while incorporating encoder-side spatial priors and decoder-side temporal priors further strengthens both capabilities, with the full 4B model reaching 56.56 on VSI-Bench and 59.74 on VLM4D.
Scaling the complete model to an 8B backbone further improves these scores to 58.16 and 61.78. Overall, the ablation results highlight the complementary roles of D-EMA for capability preservation and SDF for enhancing static and dynamic reasoning.

这一实质性的动态恢复表明,D-EMA有效缓解了3D专业培训后引入的干扰.

将完整的模型扩大为8B主干线,使这些分数进一步提高到58.16分和61.78分. 总体而言,减征结果突出了D-EMA在能力保护方面的互补作用和SDF在加强静态和动态推理方面的互补作用。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented DynThinker, a unified framework for static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning.
Our analysis reveals spatial–dynamic interference during post-training, with the balance between the two capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs.
To mitigate this interference, D-EMA preserves pretrained capabilities through group-wise temporal averaging, while SDF enhances spatial–dynamic reasoning by integrating complementary spatial and temporal priors into VLM representations under semantic guidance.
Across diverse benchmarks, DynThinker achieves strong and balanced 3D and 4D performance. Ablation and scaling studies further validate the effectiveness of parameter consolidation and dual-stream feature integration, while showing that DynThinker remains effective under dedicated 4D specialization.
Overall, our results demonstrate that strong static 3D and dynamic 4D capabilities can be unified, advancing toward general spatial intelligence.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了DynThinker,一个静态3D和动态4D空间推理的统一框架.
我们的分析揭示了后期训练期间的空间动力干扰,这两种能力之间的平衡对后期MLP的变化特别敏感.
为了减轻这种干扰,D-EMA通过分组时间平均来保留预先训练的能力,而SDF则通过在语义学指导下将互补的空间和时间前兆纳入VLM表示来增强空间-动力推理.
通过各种基准,DynThinker实现强而平衡的3D和4D性能. 缩放和缩放研究进一步验证了参数合并和双流特征集成的有效性,同时表明DynThinker在专用的4D专业化下依然有效.
总体而言,我们的结果表明,强大的静态3D和动态4D能力可以统一,向一般空间智能迈进.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement

blocks.en: This work uses publicly available research datasets and pretrained models and does not involve new data collection, private data, interaction with human subjects, or additional human annotation. We use these resources in accordance with their respective licenses and terms of use. The proposed method is intended as a research prototype for static and dynamic spatial reasoning and should not be directly deployed in embodied, robotic, autonomous-driving, or other safety-critical environments without additional validation and appropriate safeguards. As with other multimodal models, its behavior may inherit biases and failure modes from the underlying pretrained models and public datasets, including inaccurate spatial judgments and incorrect interpretations of physical dynamics. We are not aware of other specific ethical concerns arising from this work.

blocks.en: The main paper describes the model architecture, SDF, D-EMA, the unified post-training procedure, and the primary evaluation settings. The core model is trained in FP16 precision with DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 2 on 16 PPU-ZW810E accelerators with 96GB of memory each, requiring approximately eight days of training. blocks.en: Frame Sampling and Dynamic Decoding. Following GeoThinker ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we train with 32 input frames per sequence for scaled regime in the main paper. The VDPM encoder processes all 32 frames, while the sequential decoder processes features from 8 uniformly sampled frames during both training and inference. The resulting decoder features are linear interpolated along the temporal axis to construct representations for all 32 input frames. Both feature streams are subsequently resampled to the VLM’s visual token grid before fusion.
blocks.zh: 框架取样和动态解码。 GeoThinker(Li等, 2026年)之后, VDPM编码器处理所有32个帧,而相继的解码器过程则在训练和推论期间从8个被统一取样的帧中具有特征. 由此产生的解码器特征被沿着时间轴线性地插入来构建所有32个输入帧的表示. 两个功能流随后被重印到VLM的可视代号网格后再进行核聚变.

blocks.en:

4,&n>8.\end{cases} (9) This configuration reduces the visual token sequence length for longer inputs while retaining a finer spatial grid for shorter inputs. The compression threshold depends on the original input frame count n n . Consequently, our 32-frame training configuration uses spatial merge size s = 4 s=4 , with 8 frames selected for decoder processing.

blocks.en:
Table 5 examines the effects of the D-EMA drift budget, training frame count, and data scaling. Increasing the drift budget consistently improves the overall score by allowing greater adaptation, but introduces a trade-off across capabilities.
With 8-frame training, increasing the target drift budget from 12.5% to 25% raises the average score from 50.28 to 54.77.
Under 32-frame training, increasing the budget from 25% to 50% raises the average from 53.73 to 57.24, driven largely by improvements on MindCube and DSR, while reducing VLM4D from 61.3 to 57.0. Expanding the MLLM4D subset from 10% to 50% subsequently improves the average to 59.87, with particularly strong gains on DSI-G and DSI-S. Finally, adding 430K general video samples further improves SITE from 57.0 to 59.4 and VLM4D from 58.6 to 60.0, producing the final average of 60.29. Together, these results motivate the larger drift budget and progressively expanded training mixture adopted in the final model.

blocks.en: Table 6 evaluates DynThinker with different input frame budgets. Under the same 30-frame evaluation setting, DynThinker improves the overall score from GeoThinker’s 27.6 to 39.9. The largest gains occur in dynamic understanding, including ego orientation (+30.8 points), pose estimation (+19.7), and trajectory description (+16.6). With 16 evaluation frames, DynThinker achieves an overall score of 40.1, ranking fourth among the compared configurations, and obtains the highest reported 3D video grounding score of 41.9. These results demonstrate substantial improvements in spatiotemporal understanding that persist across evaluation frame budgets.

blocks.en: D.4 Comparison to GeoThinker

blocks.en: Figure 4: Comparison between GeoThinker and DynThinker across static spatial, dynamic, video understanding, and embodied benchmarks. On static spatial tasks (left), DynThinker improves on several benchmarks while obtaining competitive scores on VSI-Bench, SPAR, and VSTI. On dynamic, video, and embodied tasks (right), DynThinker improves broadly, with MVBench as the main exception.
blocks.zh: 图4:GeoThinker和DynThinker之间通过静态空间、动态、视频理解和包含的基准的比较。 在静态空间任务(左)上,DynThinker在获得VSI-Bench,SPAR,和VSTI的竞争性分数的同时,改进了几个基准. 在动态,视频,并包含的任务(右)上,DynThinker得到了广泛的改进,以MV Bench为主要例外.

blocks.en: Figure 4 provides a broader view of how DynThinker changes the capability profile of its GeoThinker baseline. On static spatial benchmarks, the results are mixed: DynThinker improves on ReVSI, MindCube, SITE, SR3D, and several other tasks, while GeoThinker retains an advantage on VSI-Bench, SPAR, and VSTI. The improvement is more consistent on dynamic reasoning, video understanding, and embodied benchmarks. DynThinker shows particularly large gains on DSR, DSI, and VLM4D, and also improves across most of the remaining benchmarks in the right panel. MVBench is the notable exception, where GeoThinker performs better. Overall, the comparison shows that DynThinker ’s strongest advance over GeoThinker lies in dynamic and embodied understanding, alongside a mixed but generally competitive static spatial profile.
blocks.zh: 图4提供了DynThinker如何改变其GeoThinker基线能力剖面的更广阔的视角. 在静态空间基准上,结果有好有坏:DynThinker改进了ReVSI,MindCube,SITE,SR3D等几项任务,而Geothinker保留了VSI-Bench,SPAR,和VSTI的优势. 在动态推理、视频理解和包含的基准方面,改进更加一致。 DynThinker在DSR,DSI和VLM4D上表现出了特别巨大的收益,并且也改善了右面板上所剩的大部分基准. MV Bench是显著的例外,其中Geothinker表现较好. 总的来说,比较表明,DynThinker在GeoThinker之上最强的进步在于动态的和体现性的理解,以及混合的、但一般具有竞争力的静态空间特征。

blocks.en: D.5.1 Physical grounding and false-premise rejection.
blocks.zh: D.5.1 物理地基和虚假的拒绝。

blocks.en: Figures 5 and 6 illustrate grounding failures examples associated with 3D-focused specialization. Although the queried objects are absent, VG-LLM and GeoThinker accept the false premises and still predict motion directions. In contrast, the pretrained Qwen3-VL-8B model correctly rejects these premises, and DynThinker preserves this behavior across both real and synthetic videos. These qualitative examples support our diagnosis of spatial–dynamic interference: 3D-focused adaptation can weaken reliance on visual evidence when making dynamic judgments.
blocks.zh: 图5和图6说明了与注重3D的专业化有关的失败实例。 尽管被询问的对象不存在,但VG-LLM和GeoThinker接受虚假的前提,仍然预测运动方向. 相形之下,预先训练的Qune3-VL-8B模型正确地拒绝了这些前提,而DynThinker在真实和合成视频中都保留了这种行为. 这些定性例子支持我们对空间动力干扰的诊断:3D聚焦的适应在做出动态判断时会削弱对视觉证据的依赖.

blocks.en: D.5.2 Motion and rotation understanding.
blocks.zh: D.5.2 动议和轮换理解。

blocks.en: Figures 7 and 8 illustrate both the retention examples of pretrained dynamic competence and further improvements in dynamic reasoning. In the real videos, DynThinker correctly identifies the stationary chameleon and the plant’s rotation from the person’s perspective, correcting errors made by both the pretrained backbone and spatially specialized models. In the synthetic videos, it retains the backbone’s correct judgments of vehicle motion and movement away from the camera, whereas VG-LLM and GeoThinker reverse the corresponding directions. Together, these cases show that DynThinker preserves reliable dynamic judgments from pretraining while improving cases that the pretrained model fails to resolve.
blocks.zh: 图7和图8说明了预先训练的动态能力的保留例子和动态推理的进一步改进。 在真实的视频中,DynThinker从人物的角度正确识别了静止的变色龙和工厂的自转,纠正了被预先训练的骨干模型和空间专门模型所犯的错误. 在合成视频中,它保留了主干对车辆运动和远离相机的正确判断,而VG-LLM和GeoThinker则颠倒了相应的方向. 这些案例加在一起表明,DynThinker从预训中保留了可靠的动态判断,同时改善了预训模型未能解决的案件.

The upper block reproduces results reported by MLLM4D, whose official evaluation uses an auxiliary language model to extract the predicted option from model-generated responses. The lower block reports results obtained with our deterministic protocol, which directly matches the output against the valid options A–D without an auxiliary evaluator. To isolate answer parsing from differences in inference frameworks or evaluation prompts, rows marked with ∗ * are rescored directly from the model responses released in the official MLLM4D repository rather than regenerated using our framework. Empty denotes responses containing no predicted answer, while Valid denotes outputs that directly match one of the four option labels. These two columns evaluate output format rather than answer correctness. blocks.en: Table 7 examines whether DynThinker ’s VLM4D gains can be attributed to differences in answer extraction. Because rerunning MLLM4D within a different framework may introduce changes in prompts or inference behavior, we directly rescore its officially released model responses using our deterministic matching protocol. The released SFT and RFT predictions already follow the required output format in 99.17% and 96.09% of cases, respectively. The remaining failures are all empty responses rather than ambiguous answers requiring semantic extraction. Re-evaluation produces scores comparable to, and generally no higher than, the officially reported results, indicating that our protocol is not more permissive and does not artificially inflate performance. Under the same deterministic evaluation, the final DynThinker model obtains 60.07, which increases to 62.27 when token compression is disabled at inference. The model trained under the MLLM4D data-scaling setting further reaches 66.74, exceeding the best officially reported overall score of 61.0 by 5.74 points. These results confirm that DynThinker ’s improvement persists under a fixed, evaluator-free protocol and is not an artifact of auxiliary answer extraction.
blocks.zh: 表7审查DynThinker的VLM4D增益是否可归因于答案提取的差异. 由于在不同的框架内重新运行MLLM4D可能会引入对提示或推论行为的改变,所以我们直接使用我们的确定匹配协议来回溯其官方发布的模型响应. 公布的SFT和RFT预测已经分别采用了99.17%和96.09%的所需产出格式. 剩下的失败都是空洞的回答,而不是需要语义提取的模糊答案. 重新评价得出的分数与官方报告的结果相当,而且一般不高于官方报告的结果,这表明我们的协议并非更宽容,也不会人为地造成业绩高涨。 在同样的定型评价下,最终的DynThinker模型获得60.07,当信使压缩在推论中被禁用时会增加到62.27. 在MLLM4D数据缩放设定下培训的模型进一步达到66.74分,超过官方报告的最佳总分61.0分5.74分. 这些结果证实,DynThinker的改进在固定的、无评估的协议下持续,并不是辅助解答提取的文物。

blocks.en: Table 9 examines how the drift budget should be allocated across pretrained parameter groups. For Qwen2.5-VL-7B, applying a shared 12.5% budget favors dynamic retention but substantially restricts spatial adaptation, yielding only 34.44 on VSI-Bench. Assigning a 12.5% budget to MLPs in blocks j > 4 j>4 and a 100% budget to the remaining pretrained parameters improves VSI-Bench to 50.37 while retaining 48.56 on VLM4D, demonstrating the benefit of asymmetric consolidation. For Qwen3-VL-8B, the shared 12.5% configuration performs best among the evaluated allocations, reaching 58.16 on VSI-Bench and 61.78 on VLM4D. We therefore use budgets of 12.5%/100% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and a shared 12.5% budget for the Qwen3-VL models.

blocks.en: Table 10 isolates the effects of Static 3D SFT, D-EMA, and SDF across three backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, direct Static 3D SFT reduces VSI-Bench from 54.90 to 52.61 and VLM4D from 57.10 to 46.75. D-EMA recovers both capabilities to 55.04 and 57.37, while adding SDF further improves them to 56.56 and 59.74. On Qwen3-VL-8B, Static 3D SFT causes only minor dynamic degradation, leaving limited room for D-EMA to improve the standalone scores, whereas SDF raises VLM4D from 59.74 to 61.78 while maintaining Static 3D performance. We hypothesize that this weaker degradation arises because Qwen3-VL already acquires substantial Static 3D knowledge during pretraining, with the larger 8B backbone retaining these priors more robustly during specialization. Nevertheless, the 52.4 VSI-Bench score of GeoThinker with the same Qwen3-VL-8B backbone in Table 8 suggests that jointly optimizing newly introduced modules can still interfere with established representations. Thus, although D-EMA provides little standalone improvement for Qwen3-VL-8B, it serves as a consolidation mechanism during joint adaptation, stabilizing pretrained representations while allowing the newly introduced SDF parameters to remain fully plastic. Overall, D-EMA is most beneficial when specialization causes substantial capability degradation, while also safeguarding pretrained representations during perceptual expansion.
blocks.zh: 表10将静态3D SFT,D-EMA,SDF三条主干线的效应隔离出. 在Qwen3-VL-4B上,直通静态3D SFT将VSI-Bench从54.90减为52.61,而VLM4D从57.10减为46.75. D-EMA将能力恢复到55.04和57.37,而加入SDF则进一步提高到56.56和59.74. 在Quen3-VL-8B上,静态3D SFT只引起轻微的动态退化,为D-EMA提供了有限的空间来提高独立的分数,而SDF则在保持静态3D性能的同时将VLM4D从59.74提高到61.78. 我们假设这种较弱的退化是由于Qune3-VL在预训期间已经获得了大量的静态3D知识,较大的8B骨干在专业化期间保留了这些前科更为有力. 尽管如此,GeoThinker的52.4 VSI-Bench分数与表8中相同的Quen3-VL-8B主干显示,联合优化新引入的模块仍会干扰已确立的表示. 因此,虽然D-EMA对Qune3-VL-8B几乎没有独立的改进,但它在联合适应期间充当了巩固机制,稳定了预先训练过的表述,同时允许新引入的SDF参数保持完全可塑. 总体而言,当专业化导致能力大幅退化时,D-EMA最为有益,同时在视觉扩张期间也保障预先训练过的表述。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol: We construct a controlled temporal-dynamic vanilla regime by augmenting the spatial reasoning vanilla training mixture with 10% of the MLLM4D ( Yin et al., 2026 ) training data (200k). The spatial mixture consists of sampled subsets of SPAR-7M ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) (234k) and the LLaVA-Hound split of LLaVA-Video-178K ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) (64k). All models are trained with 8 input frames. We evaluate spatial reasoning on VSI-Bench and temporal-dynamic understanding on VLM4D, comparing alternative capability-preservation strategies and examining inference-time frame scaling.

blocks.en: Under the matched Qwen3-VL-4B setting in Table 11 , direct SFT scores 52.61 on VSI-Bench and 46.75 on VLM4D. Freezing all MLPs raises VLM4D to 50.27 but lowers VSI-Bench to 51.41. Weight pulling periodically moves the trained weights toward their pretrained values, whereas spectral regularization penalizes changes in the spectra of weight matrices. Its large coefficients compensate for the small numerical scale of the penalty. Both strategies improve VLM4D over direct SFT but reduce VSI-Bench performance, and stronger weight pulling further degrades both scores. Conventional EMA, which uses a uniform decay, offers a better balance at 52.55 and 55.12, but still falls short of the pretrained VLM4D score of 57.10. In contrast, D-EMA reaches 55.31 on VSI-Bench and 60.57 on VLM4D, exceeding the pretrained scores on both benchmarks and achieving the best balance among the compared strategies. For Qwen3-VL-8B, the reported scores are 58.48 on VSI-Bench and 64.42 on VLM4D.

blocks.en: Table 12 reveals different scaling behaviors for static and dynamic reasoning. Without token compression, the 8B model improves on VSI-Bench from 49.93 at 8 frames to 58.93 at 64 frames, whereas its VLM4D accuracy peaks at 64.42 with 16 frames. Removing token compression consistently improves VLM4D for inputs longer than 8 frames, suggesting that temporal-dynamic reasoning benefits from finer per-frame visual evidence. Capping VDPM decoding at 8 sampled frames further enables the 8B model to process 128-frame inputs without out-of-memory failures, achieving 57.97 on VSI-Bench and 62.44 on VLM4D without token compression.
blocks.zh: 表12揭示了静态和动态推理的不同缩放行为. 没有符号压缩,8B型机车改进了VSI-Bench,从8帧的49.93到64帧的58.93,而其VLM4D精度峰值为64.42分并有16帧. 移除令牌压缩持续地改进了超过8帧的输入的VLM4D,表明时间动态推理从每帧更细的视觉证据中获益. 在8个采样帧上对VDPM解码进一步使8B模型能够处理128帧输入而不会发生出镜故障,在VSI-Bench上实现了57.97分,在VLM4D上实现了62.44分而无需象征性压缩.

blocks.en: Figure 9 examines how the MLP restoration boundary affects dynamic and spatial performance. VLM4D accuracy remains near 51% across the earliest boundaries, close to the performance obtained by restoring all MLP layers. As the boundary moves deeper, dynamic accuracy declines substantially and eventually approaches the specialized model’s performance. Meanwhile, VSI-Bench accuracy rises sharply at later boundaries, indicating that retaining more specialized MLP layers favors spatial reasoning at the expense of dynamic recovery.
blocks.zh: 图9审查了MLP恢复边界如何影响动态和空间性能。 VLM4D精度在最早的边界上保持了接近51%,接近于通过恢复所有MLP层而得到的性能. 随着边界的更深,动态精确度大幅下降,并最终接近专门模型的性能。 与此同时,VSI-Bench精度在后期边界上急剧上升,表明保留更专业的MLP层有利于空间推理而牺牲了动态恢复.

blocks.en:
We select b = 4 b=4 within the early plateau: restoring layers j > 4 j>4 recovers nearly the same dynamic performance as restoring all MLPs, with little change in spatial accuracy. This suggests that reverting the first four layers provides limited additional benefit for dynamic recovery.
Accordingly, we define MLP layers j > 4 j>4 as the interference-sensitive group in D-EMA, allowing stronger consolidation to be assigned to these layers when differentiated averaging horizons are used.
blocks.zh:
我们在早期高原内选择了 b = 4 b = 4 :恢复地层 j > 4 j > 4 恢复了几乎与恢复所有 MLP 相同的动态性能,空间精度几乎没有变化. 这表明,恢复前四层只能为动态恢复提供有限的额外好处。
因此,我们将 MLP 层 j > 4 j>4 定义为 D-EMA 中的干涉敏感组,在使用有区别的平均值时,可以对这些层进行更强的合并。

blocks.en:
The recovery of dynamic performance depends strongly on the interpolated parameter group.
Notably, fully restoring the late-layer MLPs raises VLM4D to 58.31%, exceeding both the specialized checkpoint at 50.33% and the pretrained backbone at 57.10%. This suggests that capability recovery does not require reverting the entire model. Instead, recombining preserved late-layer representations with adapted components can yield complementary benefits.
In contrast, restoring early-layer MLPs yields only 50.77%, while restoring attention parameters reduces accuracy to 47.79%.
Partial interpolation also offers a favorable trade-off: retaining 50% of the specialized late-layer MLP weights improves VLM4D accuracy to 53.13%, with VSI-Bench accuracy remaining close to the specialized checkpoint (70.89% vs. 71.06%). These findings corroborate the sensitivity of late-layer MLPs and support their selective consolidation in D-EMA with boundary b = 4 b=4 .
blocks.zh:
动态性能的恢复在很大程度上取决于插入参数组.
值得注意的是,全面恢复后期的MLP将VLM4D提高到58.31%,超过了50.33%的专业检查站和57.10%的预先培训骨干。 这表明,能力恢复不需要恢复整个模式。 相反,将保留下来的后层表述重新组合,加上经过调整的构件,可以产生互补效益。
相形之下,恢复早期的MLP的产量只有50.77%,而恢复关注参数则会将精度降低到47.79%.
部分内插也提供了有利的取舍:保留50%的专业后层MLP重量将VLM4D精度提高到53.13%,而VSI-Bench精度仍然接近专门检查站(70.09%对71.06%)。 这些结论证实了后期的MLP的敏感性,并支持它们在D-EMA中选择性地进行整合,边界为b=4b=4.

blocks.en: Baseline. StarVLA ( Community, 2026 ) is a Lego-like, open-source framework for developing vision-language-action (VLA) models with modular backbones and action heads. We adopt StarVLA-OFT as our primary embodied baseline, which provides a simple and effective VLA architecture using an MLP head to decode continuous actions.
blocks.zh: 基线. StarVLA (Community, 2026)是一个类似乐高的开源框架,用于开发有模块骨干和行动负责人的视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型. 我们采用StarVLA-OFT作为我们的主要体现基线,它提供了一个简单而有效的VLA架构,使用MLP头来解码连续动作.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol: We build the embodied variant of DynThinker upon StarVLA-OFT by incorporating our proposed SDF into its VLM backbone to selectively integrate spatial-dynamic priors for action prediction. Following the StarVLA-OFT setup on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , we train for 30,000 steps with a batch size of 16 and a learning rate of 2.5 × 10 − 5 2.5\times 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh: 评价协议: 我们通过将我们提议的SDF纳入VLM主干线,将DynThinker的内含变体建在StarVLA-OFT上,有选择地将空间动力学前科综合起来进行行动预测. 在LiBERO(Liu等,2023年)上的StarVLA-OFT设置之后,我们训练了3万步,分批大小为16个,学习速度为2.5×10−5 2.5\times 10×5}.

blocks.en: Table 15: Comparison of different VLA models on LIBERO. We train one policy for all 4 suites. All scores are averaged over 500 trials for each task suite (10 tasks × 50 episodes).
blocks.zh: 表15:LIBERO上不同VLA模型的比较. 我们为所有4个套房训练一个政策。 每套任务平均有500多场审判(10项任务×50集)。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 15 , DynThinker achieves the highest observed average success rate of 97.3% with a single policy across all four LIBERO suites. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B backbone and 30K-step training schedule, it improves over StarVLA-OFT and GeoThinker by 0.7 and 0.6 percentage points, respectively. DynThinker achieves the highest success rates on the Spatial and Object suites and improves the Long-suite result of GeoThinker from 91.2% to 92.8%. These results indicate that SDF transfers effectively to language-conditioned robot manipulation.
blocks.zh: 如表15所示,DynThinker在所有四个LIBERO套房中都实现了97.3%的最高平均成功率。 在同名的Qwen3-VL-4B骨干和30K步训练计划下,它比StarVLA-OFT和GeoThinker分别提高了0.7和0.6个百分点. DynThinker在空间和对象套房上取得了最高的成功率,并改进了GeoThinker的长套结果从91.2%到92.8%. 这些结果表明,SDF有效地转移到了语言条件机器人操纵.
